_sources: Specification: BMW Motorrad 2022 S 1000 RR technical data (EU figures) as published in Total Motorcycle's 2022 guide, https://www.totalmotorcycle.com/motorcycles/2022/2022-bmw-s1000rr, and Autocar India, https://www.autocarindia.com/bike-news-amp/2022-bmw-s-1000-rr-unveiled-gets-new-colours-m-chassis-kit-421308 (checked 2026-11-21). Model year confirmed from the photographed bike's frame number (10th character N = 2022). Photos: Providence Auto's own, album 'PT4332 - BMW - S1000 RR M Sport' (the frame-number close-up and the rear shot with the placard are not used). No colour palette: the M livery name is not confirmed on BMW's own site, so the form falls back to free-text colour.
engineConfig: Water/oil-cooled in-line four, four titanium valves per cylinder, BMW ShiftCam
transmission: 6-speed constant-mesh gearbox, anti-hopping clutch, chain drive
features: Bridge-type aluminium frame with the engine as a load-bearing element
Full Floater Pro rear suspension, fully adjustable
Twin 320 mm front discs with four-piston fixed calipers
BMW Motorrad Race ABS, ABS Pro and Dynamic Traction Control (DTC)
Riding modes Rain, Road and Dynamic
M Chassis kit, standard from the 2022 model year

notes: The BMW S 1000 RR is BMW Motorrad's 999 cc superbike, with ShiftCam variable valve timing and the electronics package BMW developed from its racing programme. The figures on this page are for the 2022 model year, the bike in the photographs. Tell us the year, the packages and the colour you want, and your consultant comes back with a landed figure for that bike before you commit.
